paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Micro-F1 scores for ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector across different values.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the Micro-F1 scores for two different methods, ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector, evaluated across various $\lambda$ values. The x-axis, labeled "$\lambda$ value", displays a sequence of discrete, evenly spaced categorical tick labels: "w/o", followed by increments of 0.1 from "0.1" to "1", and concluding with "2" and "3". The y-axis is labeled "Micro-F1 Score (%)" and employs a linear scale with numerical tick marks ranging from 52 to 58 at intervals of 1 unit. The plot contains two lines. The line representing "MatDetector (ours)" is a solid pink line with circular markers. It begins at approximately 52.9 at "w/o", dips to 52.6 at "0.2", reaches a local peak of 54.2 at "0.3", and fluctuates before rising steeply from 53.8 at "0.7" to reach its highest overall peak of 57.9 at an x-value of "1", after which it drops sharply, ending at approximately 53.4 at "3". The line representing "ChemDataExtractor" is a dashed dark blue line with square markers. It begins at approximately 52.9 at "w/o", rises slightly before dropping to its lowest point of 52.2 at "0.3", and then generally trends upward with minor fluctuations, including a dip to 53.9 at "0.9", to reach its maximum peak of 55.2 at an x-value of "1", finally declining to end at approximately 54.1 at an x-value of "3".
